name: Clangorous Soul
description: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage in exchange for the user losing 33% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stat stages would not change.
flags: Can be stolen from the original user and instead used by another Pokemon using Snatch.
Has no effect on Pokemon with the Ability Soundproof.
When used by a Pokemon, other Pokemon with the Ability Dancer can attempt to execute the same move.
